visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Find It in One Pass Without Sorting
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array is sorted with nested loops just to read the second largest value. Replace the sort with a single pass. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Sorting does far more work than the question needs and rearranges the caller's data. Remembering only the two best values takes one pass over the array and leaves it untouched.
